Kit summary

Cold ShootingBasic
Deals 280% ATK DMG to a single enemy and inflicts [Feebleness II] for 2 turns, with a 30% chance to inflict [Freeze] for 1 turn. Reduces all of self skills' CD by 1 turn after launching basic attacks proactively each time.
Cool GiftsActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 3 stages of 280% ATK DMG each to a single enemy and inflicts 1 layer of [Christmas Night] on enemies (excluding Boss) for 2 turns: For every 1 layer of [Christmas Night] owned by the target, reduces their SPD by 5%, up to 4 layers. Replaces this skill with Cool Gifts · Resonance in the duration of [Resonance Enhancement].
Peerless Pistols Lv.1Marie can gain Resonance Points when she is under [Resonance Enhancement] status. After enemies (excluding Boss) act, inflicts 1 layer of [Christmas Night] on them for 2 turns. If an enemy has 4 layers of [Christmas Night], Marie will inflict [Imprison] on them for 1 turn.
Christmas SnowPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
Marie is immune to SPD Down and Turn Meter Reduction and all of her skills' CD cannot be affected by others. Reduces all allies' DMG taken by 25% when they are attacked by heroes with countered Mark. Max Limit of Resonance Points: 10. When allies launch basic attacks or cast skills proactively, grants Marie 1 Resonance Point. When Resonance Points reach the max limit, Marie enters [Resonance Enhancement] status for 2 turns and replaces Cool Gifts with Cool Gifts · Resonance. In the duration of [Resonance Enhancement], she cannot gain Resonance Points, the Piercing Rate of Marie and the ally with the highest ATK (excluding Marie) is increased by 100%, and Marie's DMG dealt to Boss is increased to 300% of the original.
Peerless Pistols Lv.1Marie can gain Resonance Points when she is under [Resonance Enhancement] status. After enemies (excluding Boss) act, inflicts 1 layer of [Christmas Night] on them for 2 turns. If an enemy has 4 layers of [Christmas Night], Marie will inflict [Imprison] on them for 1 turn.
Peerless Pistols Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, and after every 2 of Marie's turns, grants self [Peaceful Christmas] for 2 turns: DMG taken by all allies is fixed to 1 point when they take DMG (excluding Crit DMG). Once this effect is triggered twice, it will be granted after every 4 of self turns instead; Once this effect is triggered 4 times, it will be granted after every 6 of self turns instead.
Peerless Pistols Lv.3At the beginning of each wave, Marie enters [Resonance Enhancement] status for 2 turns. In the duration of [Resonance Enhancement], after other ally casts skills to enemies proactively and deals DMG, Marie deals extra DMG by 200% of self ATK to them; for every 1 layer of [Christmas Night] owned by the target, additionally deals 50% ATK DMG to them. Each enemy can only be affected by this effect once during each of their turns and the count will be reset at the beginning of their turns.
Christmas GiftsActiveExclusive Lv.1
Grants [Block Debuff] on all allies and deals 520% ATK DMG to all enemies afterward. Meanwhile, inflicts 1 layer of [Christmas Night] on all enemies (excluding Boss) for 2 turns. If Marie is under [Resonance Enhancement] status, she will cast Cool Gifts · Resonance to pursue and attack the enemy with the highest Mastery once.
Peerless Pistols Lv.1Marie can gain Resonance Points when she is under [Resonance Enhancement] status. After enemies (excluding Boss) act, inflicts 1 layer of [Christmas Night] on them for 2 turns. If an enemy has 4 layers of [Christmas Night], Marie will inflict [Imprison] on them for 1 turn.
